classification: Illustrative planning estimates, not company actuals

sources.title: Supabase pricing
sources.finding: Pro starts at USD 25/month; first Micro project credit, database/file-storage quotas and seven-day daily database backups are included within published limits.
sources.use: USD 25 x PHP 65/USD planning conversion = PHP 1,625/month. No separate database or bundled database-backup fee. Usage taxes/card charges/overages must be confirmed before purchase.

sources.title: Cloudflare Pages limits
sources.finding: A Free plan exists, with published build and static-site limits.
sources.use: Static frontend hosting budget is PHP 0 within free static limits; backend service is budgeted separately.

sources.title: Cloudflare Registrar
sources.finding: Domain registration/renewal is at registry/ICANN cost; DNS and SSL are included.
sources.use: PHP 900/year is an analyst domain allowance, not a quoted domain price. SSL and open-source tool license budget is PHP 0.

sources.title: NWPC NCR wage information
sources.finding: The page lists a PHP 755/day non-agriculture benchmark under NCR-28 effective 26 September 2026.
sources.use: Only a Philippine costing reasonableness check. The PHP 150/hour administrative valuation is an analyst assumption, not a company wage or legal compliance conclusion. Project development retainers cover part-time services, not full-time salaries.

sources.title: BSP exchange-rate statistics
sources.use: PHP 65/USD is a rounded planning allowance, not a promised transaction rate. Replace it with the actual bank settlement rate when procuring hosting.
